label: Motion graphic
description: Short, unnarrated, design-led unit where motion is the message: kinetic type, stat hit, chart, logo sting, lower third, map, tweet/news/webpage animation. Usually under 10s.

seam.note: Single-shot pieces rarely have seams; when they do, the cut must still carry momentum.

axes.label: Signature move
axes.guidance: The one move a viewer would describe afterwards. Read hyperframes-animation/blueprints/<id>.md. If it cannot serve this content category, take the nearest blueprint that can and record the substitution in NOTES.md.

axes.label: Palette
axes.guidance: Read hyperframes-creative/palettes/<id>.md. Brand colors from the brief override palette hues but keep the palette's value structure.

axes.label: Dominant vector
values: LEFT: lateral flow, the house default
UP: everything rises toward the payoff
PUSH: camera travels forward through layers
axes.guidance: Every move in the piece rides this vector unless a visible cause spends a reserved one (motion-doctrine, The Current).

axes.label: Tempo
values: staccato: hard hits on a 0.4-0.6s grid, one 0.3-0.75s stillness before the payoff
legato: one continuous camera move that every element rides
build-and-drop: dense accumulation, then a single clean reveal on an empty frame

dimensions.question: Is there one unmistakable signature move worth rewatching, executed cleanly?

anchors.2: no identifiable move; things just appear
anchors.5: a recognizable stock move (fade-up, slide-in) done competently
anchors.8: a distinct move with a clear idea, cleanly timed
anchors.10: a move you would study and steal

dimensions.question: Is the brief's one message unmistakable at the final hold?
Do moves cause each other (causal chain), share ease intent, avoid idle wobble, and earn a stillness beat before the payoff?

anchors.5: smooth but every element animates independently

dimensions.question: Typography hierarchy, focal element, safe margins, contrast, readability at phone size in every proof frame?
Can each word be read at the speed it is on screen?

anchors.2: text gone before it can be read
anchors.10: reading rhythm is part of the design

dimensions.question: Would a designer mistake this for default AI or template output?

anchors.2: obvious template (gradient blob, Inter on black, centered fade)

fatal: text unreadable in the final hold
visible glitch: flash, pop, blank or black frame
wrong deliverable (format, length, transparent vs opaque)
required brand asset missing, distorted, or recolored
